title: Dual-Carrier Quantum Hyperbolic Movement and Weave Cocycle
question: How does the existing fixed-width R6 Bell-erasure instrument transport SL(2,R) Cartan movement when source pseudo-volume and operational quantum information are kept as heterogeneous carriers rather than collapsed to one scalar?

inside: the existing Q=+1 to SL(2,R) source map
the existing R6 normalization and five-dimensional Bell-erasure density
local trace, fidelity, Bures, Helstrom, QFI, and fixed-bipartition entanglement telemetry
normalization-cocycle accounting for compiled versus prefix-materialized words
two AION Worldlets joined by one explicitly lossy typed Tendril
an S-tier OmniTool facade for observe, weave, deweave, and append-only telemetry
outside: an optimized Shannon or quantum channel capacity
a hardware, noise, speed, memory, cognition, AGI, or quantum-advantage claim
treating Tendril.deweave as a physical inverse quantum channel

rules: W is a coupling fabric, not a residency metric.
Source pseudo-volume and operational information remain different local carriers.
Every change of decomposition, reference frame, code space, or process geometry exposes a cost and a test.
Evidence remains external; no telemetry facade promotes its own claim.
Worldlet, Tendril, weave, deweave, and OmniTool remain S-tier architecture unless their declared operators are explicitly exercised.

source.carrier: SL(2,R) determinant-one real matrices in Cartan coordinates (rho,phi,psi)
source.forbidden_projection: The split form and source volume are never used as an operational distance or as bits.

operational.carrier: five-dimensional complex density operators from the declared fixed Bell-probe erasure instrument
operational.geometry: trace distance, root fidelity, Bures distance, and SLD quantum Fisher information
operational.information: finite-ensemble PGM, Holevo, oracle-erasure, and log2-cardinality bracket in bits

preserved: rho at finite depth under exact density tomography
bridge.attenuated_not_lost: rho is not declared lost: det(A)=exp(-2*rho) recovers it in exact arithmetic, but fixed additive delta-rho sensitivity decays and tomography becomes shot-expensive.
bridge.side_channel: No free classical ||M||_2 register is supplied. Any such register, extra width, repeated use, energy, or time must be declared and charged.
bridge.nontransported_aggregate: Cartan source-volume multiplicity is a measure over source descriptions, not a state field or an operational codeword count.

exact_predictions.statement: For q=exp(-2*rho), singular values of M are (exp(rho),exp(-rho)); singular values of A are (1,q); p_Bell=(1+q^2)/2 and p_worst=q^2.
For two Bell-erasure codewords with c=Tr(A†B)/2, dense trace distance and root fidelity equal the closed forms frozen in algorithms.pairwise_geometry.
In q coordinates, J_(q,phi,psi)=diag(2/(1-q^2),(1+q)^2,(1-q)^2). Fixed delta-rho sensitivity decays, but a fixed delta-q is not declared erased.
The attempted-use QFI volume is finite: integral sqrt(det J) d rho d phi d psi = sqrt(2)*pi^3 before projective quotienting, while source slab volume has exponent two.
The typed volume-form distortion is sqrt(det J)/sqrt(abs(det g_source))=8*sqrt(2)*exp(-4rho)/sqrt(1-exp(-4rho)); it is not a common metric or capacity ratio.
kappa(X,Y)=log||X||_2+log||Y||_2-log||XY||_2 is non-negative, satisfies the two-cocycle identity, and A_X A_Y=exp(-kappa) A_XY.

For a materialized word, eta=exp(-2*kappa_word) and p_stream=eta*p_direct. For M inverse-followed-by M, source return defect is zero, conditional return fidelity is one, p_stream=exp(-4rho), and direct compilation of I succeeds with one.
Common compact SO(2) left/right frame changes preserve scale, success, pairwise trace/fidelity geometry, QFI spectrum, and ensemble Holevo information; noncompact changes are costed through kappa.
Any subsequent parameter-independent CPTP postprocessing cannot increase trace distance, QFI, accessible information, or Holevo information, and cannot decrease fidelity.

hypotheses.statement: The frozen OmniTool routing policy will deweave at least one high-depth fixed-angle radial transition below trace threshold while weaving at least one angular transition on the rho=6 boundary layer.
hypotheses.kill_condition: Falsified if either event is absent on the frozen path. This tests only the declared routing policy, not cognition or utility.

algorithms.qfi_numerical_control: Use centered Bures distances between x-h*v and x+h*v. Diagonal and pair-direction probes reconstruct the symmetric QFI without differentiating the analytic formula.
algorithms.conditional_entanglement: For the fixed Bell bipartition only, concurrence=sech(2rho) and entropy=h2(q^2/(1+q^2)). It is diagnostic, not an identity invariant.
algorithms.composition: Compare direct whole-word compilation with multiplication of normalized prefixes. Persist kappa, eta, direct success, streamed success, and the cocycle defect.
algorithms.postprocessing: Apply the frozen five-dimensional depolarizing channel rho -> (1-lambda)rho+lambda*I/5 and test data-processing directions.
algorithms.routing: For adjacent observations, weave when dense trace distance is at least 0.05 and deweave otherwise. Every event is append-only and declares its reason. The routing action is governance state, not a physical inverse.
algorithms.ensemble: Treat the unique path codewords as one uniform finite ensemble and report PGM, Holevo, oracle-erasure, and log2-cardinality as typed Bits.

controls.name: R7 and R6 binding
controls.gate: Source volume, Bell success, density validity, projective M~-M alias, split-form rejection, and the existing information sandwich remain green.

controls.name: dense versus closed pair geometry
controls.gate: Closed trace distance and fidelity agree with dense spectral calculations within 1e-10, and Fuchs-van de Graaf plus Helstrom bounds hold.

controls.name: QFI reconstruction
controls.gate: Numerical Bures reconstruction agrees with the analytic QFI on every frozen interior point within 0.5 percent relative error.

controls.name: rank-changing boundary
controls.gate: rho=0 is handled by finite trace/fidelity probes and is never passed to the interior SLD-QFI API.

controls.name: coordinate compactification
controls.gate: q decreases monotonically to zero, J_rhorho has high-depth log slope -4 within 0.02, J_qq remains finite near q=0, and the analytic total QFI volume matches sqrt(2)*pi^3.

controls.name: normalization cocycle
controls.gate: kappa is non-negative, the cocycle defect is below 1e-10, and normalized-product plus stream/direct identities hold.

controls.name: source echo versus attempted survival
controls.gate: Every frozen inverse pair has source defect below 1e-10, conditional fidelity one within 1e-10, and the two declared success laws.

controls.name: CPTP data processing
controls.gate: The frozen depolarizing channel never increases dense trace distance, never decreases root fidelity, and its finite-difference QFI does not exceed the input beyond numerical tolerance.

controls.name: compact frame and matched compact family
controls.gate: Common SO(2) frame attacks preserve the declared invariants, while the existing matched SU(2) family keeps the same probe and density width.

controls.name: typed AION seam
controls.gate: Two different Worldlet geometries are present; the Tendril lists preserved, transformed, lost, cost, typed remainder, and absent return reason; source Quantity and operational Bits refuse comparison.

controls.name: weave/deweave history
controls.gate: Empty deweave reasons are refused, routing events are append-only, and physical echo_transport is never implemented through Tendril.deweave.

controls.name: information and evidence
controls.gate: The finite ensemble obeys PGM<=Holevo<=oracle<=log2N; output binds the frozen manifest, source, tests, and runner in an EvidenceEnvelope without claiming independence.

verdict_rules.P: Any failed exact identity or typed-carrier control voids the run rather than weakening a tolerance after observation.
verdict_rules.H1: SURVIVES only if both the high-depth radial deweave and boundary angular weave are present on the frozen path; otherwise FALSIFIED.
verdict_rules.overall: The strongest allowed result is an exact and finite-grid characterization of one fixed-width attempted-use instrument plus an S-tier routing trace. It is not a general channel-capacity or cognitive-performance result.

source_boundary: The frozen equations specific to this repository's Bell-erasure construction are local derivations checked by controls, not statements attributed verbatim to the cited papers.
kill_conditions: Adding, averaging, ranking, or optimizing source pseudo-volume and operational bits as one scalar.
Calling the indefinite source Q=+1 geometry positive-definite H3.
Calling rho literally lost at finite depth when exact tomography can recover q=exp(-2rho).
Calling fixed-rho QFI decay deletion of a fixed-q distinction.
Treating source volume, constructed descriptions, N*p, QFI volume, or catalogue size as channel capacity.
Treating Tendril.deweave as M inverse or as a CPTP recovery map.
Keeping ||M||_2 as an uncharged infinite-precision classical side register.
Changing the path, threshold, finite-difference step, channel, controls, or tolerances after observing outputs.
Claiming quantum advantage, hardware performance, noise robustness, cognition, consciousness, AGI, or general memory benefit.
